Requirement: Wheel demand shall include inertia, rolling, grade, and aerodynamic forces.
AcceptanceCriterion: Hand calculation within 2% for constant-speed case

Requirement: Auxiliaries shall consume energy at zero vehicle speed.
AcceptanceCriterion: Positive energy delta and analytical match

Requirement: Motor and reduction limits shall report unmet traction demand.
AcceptanceCriterion: Unmet energy is positive when saturated

Requirement: The combined DC boundary shall conserve energy within tolerance.
AcceptanceCriterion: Integrated absolute residual below tolerance

Requirement: Exactly one battery shall be active for traction at a time.
AcceptanceCriterion: Role swap obeys fixed 30% rule

Requirement: The genset shall charge only the standby battery at constant optimum power.
AcceptanceCriterion: No traction offset and fixed nonzero genset command

Requirement: Regeneration shall serve auxiliaries, active battery, then load bank.
AcceptanceCriterion: Allocation identity closes and surplus reaches load bank

Requirement: Pneumatic friction brakes shall supply wheel-braking demand beyond regenerative capability.
AcceptanceCriterion: Braking demand equals regenerative plus pneumatic plus explicitly unmet braking power

Requirement: Battery energy and SOE shall remain within configured bounds.
AcceptanceCriterion: No upper or lower bound violation

Requirement: Battery charge-current limit, discharge-current limit, and internal resistance shall vary with SOE and temperature; OCV shall vary with SOC and temperature; terminal power capability shall be derived.
EquationReference: Battery lookup maps / first-order Thevenin relation
EvidenceSignal: Battery1/2 current limits, OCV, derived power capability, resistance, terminal voltage, current, ohmic loss
AcceptanceCriterion: Cold and high-SOE derating observed; terminal electrical identities close; both SLX models use lookup-driven saturation

Requirement: Route geometry, display elevation, and time histories shall be ordered, finite, and traceable.
AcceptanceCriterion: One MAT file per route with valid coordinate/elevation bounds, provenance, and strictly ordered sequence

Requirement: Every selectable battery and motor shall be sourced from one versioned MATLAB data file.
AcceptanceCriterion: One schema-valid MATLAB file per unique battery and motor ComponentID

Requirement: Every selectable genset shall be sourced from one versioned MATLAB file containing its matched engine, generator, fuel map, and efficiency map.
AcceptanceCriterion: One schema-valid, internally matched MATLAB file per unique genset ComponentID

Requirement: Users shall be able to add batteries, motors, and genset assemblies with nonnumeric IDs without changing central application code.
EquationReference: Recursive component discovery / explicit assembly links
AcceptanceCriterion: Arbitrary safe IDs load, validate, survive built-in regeneration, and complete a simulation; duplicates are rejected case-insensitively

Requirement: Repeated identical inputs shall produce repeatable results.
AcceptanceCriterion: Bitwise-identical scalar KPI result

Requirement: Ranked configurations shall be feasible and sorted by cost per kilometre.
AcceptanceCriterion: Feasible cases sorted in ascending objective

Requirement: Performance mode shall calculate nonnegative achieved speed and monotonically nondecreasing actual distance after component force limits.
EquationReference: Forward longitudinal force balance and discrete integration
AcceptanceCriterion: Capable vehicle completes; limited vehicle never rolls backward

Requirement: Grade and auxiliary demand in Performance mode shall be sampled using actual travelled distance.
AcceptanceCriterion: Grade transition occurs at its route distance, independent of startup delay

Requirement: Sustained inability to overcome road load shall terminate as a stalled, incomplete route rather than crediting prescribed-speed completion.
AcceptanceCriterion: Severe underpowered grade case reports stall, incomplete route, and no rollback

Requirement: Both BEV and Hybrid shall run under the forward formulation while the dispatcher preserves the legacy backward result.
EquationReference: Common result contract and formulation dispatcher
AcceptanceCriterion: Both forward modes conserve energy and backward results remain identical

Requirement: The editable forward model shall separate route/terrain, driver/demand, component limits, and vehicle plant into documented subsystems.
AcceptanceCriterion: Four documented feature subsystems compile and structural checks pass

Requirement: Constrained mode shall suppress acceleration using battery-current/energy, motor torque-speed/power, final-drive force, and road-load capability.
EquationReference: Acceleration suppression around backward energy kernel
AcceptanceCriterion: Limited case achieves lower acceleration/speed than the capable case

Requirement: Constrained mode shall use one fixed route-time horizon, actual-distance terrain, and nonnegative speed/distance.
AcceptanceCriterion: Terrain transition follows actual distance and sample count equals one route pass

Requirement: Constrained mode shall support BEV and Hybrid and stop a depleted vehicle without rollback.
AcceptanceCriterion: Depleted vehicle remains stopped; both powertrains conserve energy

Requirement: MATLAB and Simulink implementations shall agree within declared tolerances.
AcceptanceCriterion: Every signal check passes its declared tolerance
